subject.title: [Feature]: Intelligent Model Fallback with Wildcard/Auto Selection

question: Should OpenClaw add a core provider-family fallback contract for wildcard/auto, fallbackFamilies, or catalog-derived fallback selection, and which one should be canonical?
rationale: This changes public model config semantics and provider/auth fallback behavior; AGENTS.md treats fallback and config surfaces as product decisions rather than implementation conveniences.

options.title: Define one core fallback contract
options.body: Pick a single canonical config shape and require schema, docs, runtime, and upgrade proof before implementation.

options.title: Limit scope to catalog-derived fallback PR
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/60922 as the only near-term path and leave wildcard/auto or fallbackFamilies for a later design issue.

options.title: Keep fallback policy explicit only
options.body: Reject new family/auto fallback config for now and ask users to maintain explicit agents.defaults.model.fallbacks lists or plugin-owned routing.

recommendation.title: Define one core fallback contract
recommendation.body: Pick a single canonical config shape and require schema, docs, runtime, and upgrade proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the clearest feature-history ownership over the model fallback resolver and config/fallback boundary touched by this decision.
